name: Cyclone-4M
description: Three-stage small launch vehicle for Spaceport Nova Scotia (Canso). Values are taken from the Cyclone-4M SLS Abbreviated User's Guide where it states them, and are flagged ASSUMPTION with the reasoning recorded where it does not.

guide.title: Cyclone-4M SLS Abbreviated User's Guide, Version 2

t_to_inj_source: ASSUMPTION. The Abbreviated User's Guide section 2.5.2 Table 2.2 flight timeline gives T+9 s first motion, T+12 s pitch and roll to the launch azimuth, T+75 s cross-range manoeuvre and T+261 s stage 1 separation. It does not publish a time to orbit. 540 s (T+9 min) is taken as the class floor for a direct LEO insertion, consistent with the 10 to 60 min direct-ascent range recorded in spec II.5.

ascent_profile.source: Cyclone-4M Abbreviated User's Guide section 2.5.2 Table 2.2, flight timeline

hazard_footprint.source: The Nova Scotia Registration Document June 2018 section 5 places the drop 'just over 2,000 km south of the launch site' and gives the pad hazard area as 'a radius of less than 500 metres'. The cross-range axis is not published and is assumed.
hazard_footprint.downrange_rationale: Registration Document June 2018 section 5: the vehicle would fall into the Atlantic Ocean 'just over 2,000 km south of the launch site'. Treated as the debris downrange extent.

published_azimuths.context: SC insertion into a 200 km orbit inclined at 51.6 deg
SSO insertion, with a cross-range manoeuvre to the right at T+75 s to bypass Little Dover
approximate trajectory used for the sonic boom overpressure study, 6.9 psf at 60 km
published_azimuths.source: Nova Scotia Registration Document June 2018, Project 16-5903, section 5, Figure 5.4

lateral_manoeuvre.source: Cyclone-4M Abbreviated User's Guide section 2.3: 'For launches into orbits with inclination less than 45.1 deg, the Cyclone-4M can perform a lateral manoeuvre at the equator.' This is the vehicle guide's own note on the impossibility the engine reports, and it is cited in the response provenance.

advertised_inclinations_source: Cyclone-4M Abbreviated User's Guide section 2.3 and Figure 2.1: 'inclined at 51.6 deg, 87.9 deg, and 98.1 deg', with the 45.1 deg lateral-manoeuvre threshold in section 2.3.
paired_profile_rationale: A second profile with a published-coast ascent, so the fixed-point tests can prove that T_to_inj flows through the solver rather than being a constant in it.

rows.source: Not published. Derived from the section 2.5.2 timeline; see t_to_inj_source.
